pr_snapshot.body:
The bounded Release 4 proposal is open for discussion, but its arithmetic has no reviewed execution candidate with original-input error evidence. Existing cell/QR/scaling probes expose range, cancellation and exact-zero failures.

This Lane 1 research packet compares the three historical graphs, their scaled forms and a minimal anchored-cell alternative, and adds an exploratory integer-lattice candidate with adjacent-binary64 enclosures. A separate Fraction-based oracle computes expectations directly from declared inputs; no candidate output is used as an expectation.

Fixed base / sole parent: dedd26a3e0655001b67e40ccfb741e43ecb07beb.
Separate proposal/opening input: 022c8699befbcba375e3aa6e07c1a8dd8eace483.
Review head: 2864903316b4b4b2b219a56b42c535bfec7935b3.
Tree: 78a8df1ddb1269de451751419aa915a3179e70d1.
Main was rechecked equal to the fixed base. The proposal branch is not substituted for that base, and the base's residual-location correction is retained.

Start with governance/drafts/release-4-preparation/arithmetic-candidate-20260910/REPORT.md, INPUTS.json, VALIDATION.md and SHA256SUMS. All 28 added files are confined to this new directory; all baseline files remain unchanged.

Validation:
- 968 datasets, including all 945 historical cases: 18,380 exact quantity equalities and 18,380 enclosure/projection checks pass.
- Independent algorithmic oracle, deterministic replay, historical corpus digest, sign/order/scale checks and exact/rounded-zero diagnostics pass.
- 20,470 exponent-edge decoding checks and four finite workloads through 16,384 observations pass.
- Formatting, Markdown lint (400 files), typecheck, direct node/tsx validation, generated drift (19 files), diff check and 27 artifact checksums pass.
- The pnpm validate wrapper failed on an IPC-pipe EPERM; the same validator passed via node --import tsx. Node/pnpm environment differences and unrun full suites are documented.

Findings include a 50% SSE error from computing residuals around a rounded cell mean, spurious finite QR F values for exact-zero effects, and the failure of scaling alone to preserve every mixed-scale input. The integer path is a review candidate, not a formally adopted algorithm. Finite observed errors are not tolerances or whole-domain guarantees.

Lane 2 receives a proposed original-input rational F/enclosure interface, exact df and exact-zero-SSE versus positive-underflow states. No Lane 2 result is consumed and no tail algorithm is implemented.

Authorship and execution: OpenAI Codex in the author task context, with continuity summaries visible; no independent investigator, human review or sub-agent is claimed. Candidate/oracle separation is algorithmic only. Research Gate review, supported resources/platforms, final projection/admission/comparison policy and tail integration remain open.

Draft PR for independent candidate review only. No merge, formal adoption, identifier/bundle registration, new gate or release is requested.
